ترايقت (form VI)
# تَرَايَقْتُ (tarāyaqtu) /ta.raː.jaq.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَرَايَقَ (tarāyaqa)
# تَرَايَقْتَ (tarāyaqta) /ta.raː.jaq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَرَايَقَ (tarāyaqa)
# تَرَايَقْتِ (tarāyaqti) /ta.raː.jaq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَرَايَقَ (tarāyaqa)
# تَرَايَقَتْ (tarāyaqat) /ta.raː.ja.qat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
